title: Offer AI Agent Swarms Under Your Brand | AIify Partner Program
description: Offer your clients done-for-them AI agent swarms under your brand. You keep the client and set the price. We co-manage the work behind you for a fixed fee.

hero.heading: Give your clients a premium AI offer under your brand.
hero.body: Offer your clients a premium offer they really want: done-for-them AI agent swarms, co-managed by our expert AI management team. You keep your clients, and we serve them with you.

intro.heading: You have the clients. Now you have the offer.
body: Your clients trust you. They want AI that changes how their business runs, and they would rather get it from you than from someone new.
The hard part comes after the sale. Someone has to build the system, work with the people, and stay with it every week. You don't have to staff that. You make the offer. We do the work behind you.

points.title: A premium offer under your brand.
points.body: Done-for-them AI agent swarms, sold by you to clients who already trust you.

points.title: No AI team to build.
points.body: You don't hire, train, or manage anyone. We do.

intro.builtFor: Business owners, firms, advisors, and networks in any industry who already have clients.

model.heading: What your clients get
model.body: Many companies buy AI software and nobody uses it. Your clients get people, not just software. We set the swarm up for them, build it with them every week, and check on it every day. That's why it gets used, and why your clients stay happy with you.
model.label: How it works

steps.title: You bring the client.
steps.body: You make the offer under your brand and set your price.

steps.title: Set up for them.
steps.body: We set up the AI agent swarm around how their business already runs.

steps.title: Built with them every week.
steps.body: At the start, each user gets a weekly build session with us of about 30 minutes. We log in remotely every day to check on it and keep it working.

steps.title: Aimed at their goals.
steps.body: Each quarter, we set their goals in the system so the work stays focused. Live dashboards show their team how the business is running.

steps.title: Credit goes to their people.
steps.body: Their team builds it with us, so their team gets the credit. You keep the client.

model.platform: We currently co-manage in Grok Bot, and our approach doesn't depend on any one platform.

evidence.heading: What it looks like when it works
evidence.body: This is a recent engagement we ran directly. It's one engagement, not a guarantee. It shows what your clients could get.
facts: We connected to their systems, including one with no API. For that one, we sign in and pull the numbers several times during the workday.
We built live dashboards their team uses to run the business.
Within two weeks, the savings covered more than a year of the cost.
evidence.closing: That's the result you want under your brand.

economics.label: Partner economics
economics.heading: You set the price. We charge a fixed fee. The difference is yours.
economics.body: We charge a fixed wholesale fee per seat each month. You decide what your client pays.
economics.market: Partners often charge about $10,000 a month. That's an example, not a requirement. You set the price.
economics.price: Tool-only seats without co-management run around $500 per seat per month. That's just software. You're offering the people who make it work, and that's why it's premium.

ownership.label: What you keep
ownership.heading: Your client. Your work. Your long-term position.

points.title: You keep the client.
points.body: Your client buys from you and works with you. We serve them with you, behind your brand.

points.title: You own the client work.
points.body: What we build for each client is yours: their instructions, playbooks, and agent setups. AIify keeps its methods.

points.title: You keep a long-term offer.
points.body: This is a long-term engagement. Building it in-house later is rarely cheaper. You can offer your clients an arrangement that keeps working.

questions.a: You are the face of the offer and you own the relationship. We are your backend.

questions.q: Shouldn't we just build this team ourselves?
questions.a: It's rarely cheaper. You'd have to hire, train, and manage the team yourself. With us, you get the offer without the headcount.
No. Software is a small part of it. Your clients get setup, weekly build sessions, daily check-ins, and quarterly goals.
